title: Write one function for any kind with some type
objective: Use some type in a function so it takes and returns a value of whatever kind the caller passes.

body.text: Sometimes a function works the same way for numbers, texts, or anything else. Write some type for a parameter whose kind you do not fix in advance. Each call decides the kind: if you pass numbers, the parameter is a number. The returns line with some type says the result has the same kind as the value the function receives.

body.title: Choose one of two values
body.code:
function choose
    takes some type called left
    takes some type called right
    returns some type
    gives back left

say choose 1 and 2
say choose "sun" and "moon"

body.text: A list can hold any kind too. Write a list of some type, and the function returns a value of the same kind as the items in the list.

body.title: The first item of any list
body.code:
function first item
    takes a list of some type called items
    returns some type
    gives back items at 0

make list equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
say first item list

body.prompt: The program shows choose working with numbers, printing 1. Show it working with text as well, so the program also prints red.
body.starter:
function choose
    takes some type called left
    takes some type called right
    returns some type
    gives back left

say choose 1 and 2
body.solution:
function choose
    takes some type called left
    takes some type called right
    returns some type
    gives back left

say choose 1 and 2
say choose "red" and "blue"
